candidates.source_name: CBCG — Novac u opticaju / Money in Circulation (currency section)
candidates.why_relevant: Central Bank of Montenegro's dedicated currency section covering banknotes and coins in circulation in a euroised economy. Root node for all cash-cycle sub-pages (counterfeiting protection, unfit-currency replacement, jubilee money). English mirror at /en/currency/money-in-circulation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML crawl of /me/novac/* and /en/currency/* subtrees; diff page content and harvest linked PDFs.
queries_used: Montenegro central bank cash operations currency in circulation euroisation report
CBCG falsifikovane novčanice izvještaj kvalitet novčanica gotovina u opticaju

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Zaštita eura od falsifikovanja / Protection of Euro Banknotes and Coins against Counterfeiting
candidates.why_relevant: CBCG is the national analysis centre (NAC/CNAC equivalent) for euro counterfeits in Montenegro. Counterfeit-detection counts by denomination are periodically released (e.g. 848 counterfeit notes worth EUR 71,660 in 2024, +61.8% y/y, per Montenegrin media citing CBCG) and drive demand for detection/authentication hardware in cash handling.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl page + linked PDFs; cross-check annually against CBCG press releases (saopstenja) mentioning 'falsifikati'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from CBCG currency section + sr media search
queries_used: CBCG falsifikovane novčanice izvještaj kvalitet novčanica gotovina u opticaju

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Zamjena oštećenih novčanica i kovanog novca / Replacement of Unfit Currency
candidates.why_relevant: Documents CBCG's banknote-fitness/unfit-currency replacement service — the closest Montenegrin analogue to banknote-processing/sorting operations. Useful for sizing cash-quality handling and vault/processing workload in a country that does not issue its own currency.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML scrape; treat as procedural/qualitative unless volumes appear in the Annual Work Report.
queries_used: Montenegro central bank cash operations currency in circulation euroisation report

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Izvještaj o radu CBCG (Annual Work Report)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most likely home of narrative cash-operations reporting: activity of the treasury/vault organisational unit (poslovi sa gotovinom), volumes of cash received/paid out to banks, counterfeit withdrawals, unfit-note replacement. Because euroised Montenegro has no issuance report, this substitutes for the 'cash report' other central banks publish.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest full PDF back-series; keyword-extract sections on 'gotovina', 'trezor', 'falsifikati', 'novčanice'.
queries_used: CBCG izvještaj o poslovima sa gotovinom Crna Gora
cbcg.me "poslovi sa gotovinom" OR "gotovinski poslovi" sektor za trezor godišnji izvještaj o radu

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu (quarterly payment-services datasets)
candidates.why_relevant: The richest machine-readable cash-cycle series for Montenegro. Quarterly ZIP datasets include 'Platne transakcije uplate i isplate gotovog novca' (cash deposit/withdrawal transactions), 'Broj uređaja za prihvatanje platnih kartica' (acceptance-device counts, i.e. ATM/POS estate), and 'Platne transakcije izvršene platnim karticama po vrsti terminala' (card transactions split by terminal type — the ATM-withdrawal series). Directly determines cash-handling and ATM demand.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled quarterly download of the ZIP bundles under /slike_i_fajlovi/fajlovi/fajlovi_publikacije/statistika/, unzip and parse the Excel tables into a time series.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sr search on 'bankomat' + snowball from CBCG statistics
queries_used: CBCG "bankomat" statistika broj bankomata POS terminala podizanje gotovine

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Odluka o izvještajima koji se dostavljaju CBCG o platnom prometu (BUPPK reporting decision + annexes)
candidates.why_relevant: The reporting decision and its annex forms define exactly which cash/ATM/POS fields payment service providers must report quarterly (e.g. BUPPK — number of acceptance devices such as ATMs and POS terminals; separate lines for ATM cash withdrawals and cash deposits). This is the schema key that makes the published ZIP datasets interpretable, and it reveals fields that exist but are not published.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off PDF download and field-dictionary extraction; re-check on each amendment of the decision.
queries_used: CBCG "bankomat" statistika broj bankomata POS terminala podizanje gotovine

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Statistika platnog prometa: pokazatelji RTGS/DNS (monthly ZIP)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly payment-system indicators (RTGS/DNS) plus an archived national payment transactions series through 31.12.2017. Provides the settlement-side counterpart to cash flows and lets cash withdrawal volumes be normalised against total payment turnover.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly fetch of pokazatelji_platnog_prometa_<month>_<year>.zip and the archived historical ZIP; parse to time series.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of CBCG statistics page
queries_used: CBCG izvještaj o poslovima sa gotovinom Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Bilten CBCG (monthly statistical bulletin)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly bulletin with a large statistical annex covering monetary developments, the banking system, balance of payments and payment flows. In a euroised economy this is where cash-proxy aggregates (currency outside banks, deposits, payment turnover) are most consistently published as a long back-series, both sr and en columns in the same PDF.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly PDF harvest from /fajlovi_publikacije/biltencbcg/<year>/; table extraction (bilingual headers make column mapping easy). Deep archive back to at least 2010.
queries_used: Bilten CBCG mjesečni statistički bilten gotovina novac u opticaju Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Monetarna i finansijska statistika (Monetary and Financial Statistics)
candidates.why_relevant: Monetary survey / depository corporations series. Under unilateral euroisation there is no domestic issuance figure, so 'currency in circulation' must be estimated from these aggregates (deposits, currency outside banks proxies) — this is the primary input table for any Montenegrin cash-in-circulation estimate.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of the Excel table links on the page.
queries_used: Bilten CBCG mjesečni statistički bilten gotovina novac u opticaju Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Euroizacija / Euroisation policy page
candidates.why_relevant: CBCG's own statement of what unilateral euroisation means for its operations: it cannot control money supply, euro quantity in circulation depends on ECB policy, capital inflows, tourism, remittances and the population's propensity to hold cash. Establishes the structural reason Montenegrin cash data is fragmented and why demand drivers are external.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off scrape; monitor for revisions (EU accession/ERM debates would change it).
queries_used: Montenegro central bank cash operations currency in circulation euroisation report

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Godišnji izvještaj / Macroeconomic Annual Report
candidates.why_relevant: Annual macro report normally carries a payment-system and banking-sector chapter with year-end ATM/POS estate counts and card transaction totals, giving an authoritative annual anchor for the quarterly ZIP series.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF harvest, back-series; extract payment-system chapter tables.
queries_used: cbcg.me "poslovi sa gotovinom" OR "gotovinski poslovi" sektor za trezor godišnji izvještaj o radu

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Izvještaj o finansijskoj stabilnosti / Financial Stability Report
candidates.why_relevant: Financial stability reporting in a euroised system pays unusual attention to liquidity and cash holdings of banks (no ELA backstop). Useful for bank vault-cash levels and the systemic framing of cash dependence.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF harvest; keyword scan for 'gotovina', 'likvidna sredstva'.
queries_used: Montenegro central bank cash operations currency in circulation euroisation report

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Finansijski iskazi CBCG (audited financial statements)
candidates.why_relevant: Audited CBCG balance sheet discloses 'gotovina u trezoru' (cash in vault) and cash-equivalent definitions — a rare hard number on the central bank's own physical euro holdings, which is the only issuance-side quantity a euroised central bank controls.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF harvest (2014-present observed); extract cash-and-cash-equivalents note.
queries_used: cbcg.me "poslovi sa gotovinom" OR "gotovinski poslovi" sektor za trezor godišnji izvještaj o radu

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Saopštenja / press releases and news (aktuelno)
candidates.why_relevant: Counterfeit-statistics releases, cash-handling advisories and Council decisions surface here first and are what Montenegrin media then quote. Best early-warning feed for cash-cycle developments between annual reports.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the saopstenja listing; keyword filter on gotovin*, falsifikat*, bankomat*, novčanic*.
queries_used: cbcg.me "poslovi sa gotovinom" OR "gotovinski poslovi" sektor za trezor godišnji izvještaj o radu

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Radne studije (Working Papers series)
candidates.why_relevant: CBCG Research and Statistics Department working-paper series; the natural home of any Montenegrin cash-demand / cash-usage / euroisation-cost study. Confirmed to exist (e.g. Working Study no. 10 on financial-market analysis).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the working-paper index; download PDFs and keyword-screen for gotovina/tražnja za novcem/euroizacija.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sr search, followed PDF to series
queries_used: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore bilten bankarstvo bankomati kartice statistika

candidates.source_name: IMF — Montenegro country page (Article IV, Technical Assistance reports)
candidates.why_relevant: IMF staff explicitly model Montenegrin currency-in-circulation: a 2026 technical assistance report estimated seigniorage lost to unilateral euroisation using historical CiC data multiplied by an opportunity-cost proxy. That is one of the very few published CiC estimates for Montenegro and it comes with methodology.
candidates.legal_status: public, redistribution restricted by IMF copyright
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the country publications feed; download PDFs and extract CiC/seigniorage tables. Cite rather than redistribute.
queries_used: Montenegro central bank cash operations currency in circulation euroisation report

candidates.source_name: Euronet Worldwide — investor relations / IAD network announcements
candidates.why_relevant: Independent ATM deployers are a material and growing part of Montenegro's ATM estate (tourism-driven, high-fee), and they are invisible in bank-level data. Euronet press releases and 10-K segment commentary reveal IAD market entry and network scale in Southeast Europe, which the CBCG acceptance-device counts do not attribute by operator.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor IR news feed and annual 10-K EMEA ATM counts; keyword filter on Montenegro / Balkans / IAD.
queries_used: Euronet Montenegro ATM network independent ATM deployer Crna Gora bankomati mreža

candidates.source_name: RTCG — Radio Televizija Crne Gore, economy desk
candidates.why_relevant: National public broadcaster; its economy desk reports ATM fee levels (e.g. reporting EUR 3-5 withdrawal commissions as a burden on consumers) and cash-access complaints. Reveals ATM pricing and branch/ATM withdrawal behaviour that no official dataset publishes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-monitored crawl/RSS on bankomat, provizija, gotovina, podizanje novca; store links + summaries, not full text.
queries_used: CBCG "bankomat" statistika broj bankomata POS terminala podizanje gotovine

candidates.source_name: PV Informer / Montenegrin online media reporting CBCG counterfeit data
candidates.why_relevant: Montenegrin outlets routinely restate CBCG counterfeit findings (most-counterfeited denominations, coins included) with more detail and earlier than the consolidated annual report. Serves as a discovery layer pointing back to the underlying CBCG release.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword alerts on 'falsifikovane novčanice Crna Gora'; always trace back to the CBCG primary release before using a number.
queries_used: CBCG falsifikovane novčanice izvještaj kvalitet novčanica gotovina u opticaju

candidates.source_name: MONSTAT — Anketa o potrošnji domaćinstava (Household Budget Survey)
candidates.why_relevant: The only recurring Montenegrin household-level instrument that could carry payment-instrument questions. Its published outputs are expenditure structure rather than payment method, but the methodology document and microdata request route are the realistic path to any Montenegrin cash-usage-at-point-of-sale evidence.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download annual saopštenje PDFs and the methodology paper; if payment-mode variables are absent, log as a structural gap rather than re-querying.
queries_used: Monstat anketa o potrošnji domaćinstava Crna Gora gotovinsko plaćanje

candidates.source_name: MONSTAT — publications index (Uprava za statistiku Crne Gore)
candidates.why_relevant: Master index of Montenegrin official statistics releases; the discovery layer for tourism arrivals, retail turnover and remittance-adjacent series that drive seasonal cash demand in a euroised, tourism-heavy economy.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the publications index periodically to detect new releases; subscribe to novosti/arhiva page.
queries_used: Monstat anketa o potrošnji domaćinstava Crna Gora gotovinsko plaćanje

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Registar banaka (bank register) and Finansijski izvještaji banaka
candidates.why_relevant: Actor map for the cash cycle: the authoritative list of licensed banks (CKB, NLB, Hipotekarna, Prva banka, Erste, Lovcen, Adriatic, Universal Capital, Ziraat, etc.) whose own annual reports and ATM-locator pages are the only per-operator ATM/branch cash data. Bank quarterly/annual statements also disclose vault cash.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the register to build the bank actor list; then crawl each bank's ATM-locator and annual report for ATM counts and cash-in-vault figures.
queries_used: CBCG izvještaj o poslovima sa gotovinom Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: CBCG — Odluka o unosu i iznosu gotovine iz Crne Gore (cross-border cash declaration rules)
candidates.why_relevant: Regulation on how much cash may be brought into/out of Montenegro without declaration. In a euroised, tourism-dependent economy physical euro enters mainly through travellers and remittances, so declaration thresholds and (if published) Customs declaration totals are a genuine indirect measure of cash inflow.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the podzakonski-akti index; pair with Uprava carina (Customs Administration) reports for declared cash-crossing volumes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sr search result summary, followed to regulation index
queries_used: CBCG izvještaj o poslovima sa gotovinom Crna Gora

candidates.source_name: ECB — Euro banknote and counterfeiting statistics (euro area issuer perspective)
candidates.why_relevant: Montenegro uses euro banknotes it does not issue, so ECB series (banknotes in circulation by denomination, semiannual counterfeit statistics, series/ES2 rollout and the future digital euro) set the physical product cycle Montenegrin cash handlers must follow. Also the benchmark against which CBCG counterfeit rates are judged.
candidates.legal_status: public official content, ECB reuse terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Semiannual counterfeit press-release capture plus ECB Data Portal banknote-circulation series; use as euro-area denominator.
queries_used: Montenegro central bank cash operations currency in circulation euroisation report

negative_findings.description: No standalone CBCG cash-operations report exists. Searches in Serbian for 'izvještaj o poslovima sa gotovinom' returned only the generic Izvještaj o radu CBCG, the audited financial statements and unrelated supervisory reporting decisions — no dedicated cash/vault report analogous to the cash reports issued by issuing central banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cash-operations narrative appears to be embedded as a section inside the Annual Work Report rather than published separately; not yet verified inside a PDF.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline expecting a discrete 'cash report' document for Montenegro will find nothing; the collector must PDF-mine the Annual Work Report instead.

negative_findings.description: Because Montenegro uses the euro unilaterally and does not issue it, no national currency-in-circulation statistic is published by CBCG. CBCG's own euroisation page states it cannot control the money supply and that euro quantity in circulation depends on ECB policy and external flows.
negative_findings.result_summary: CiC for Montenegro exists only as an estimate — the clearest one located is an IMF technical assistance estimate built from historical CiC data for a seigniorage-loss calculation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The headline metric a cash-cycle analyst would normally anchor on does not exist as an official series; estimates and their methodology must be sourced and caveated.

negative_findings.description: The CBCG English payment-system statistics page exposes only RTGS/DNS indicator ZIPs and a historical national payment transactions ZIP frozen at 31.12.2017; it lists no ATM/POS or cash-withdrawal dataset. The ATM/POS and cash withdrawal data are instead on the Montenegrin-language 'Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu' page under key functions, not under Statistics.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only navigation would have missed the ATM/POS and cash-withdrawal series entirely; the Serbian-language route found them.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Concrete demonstration that English-only discovery under-covers Montenegro, and a warning that the collector must target the platni-promet path, not the statistika path.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegrin equivalent of the ECB SPACE study or a national payment-diary/cash-usage survey was located. MONSTAT's Household Budget Survey publishes expenditure structure (food 37.1%, housing/utilities 15.1% in the 2021 wave, 1,333 households) but the published outputs contain no payment-instrument or cash-share variable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in Serbian with 'gotovinsko plaćanje' and 'anketa o potrošnji domaćinstava'; no cash-share-of-payments survey surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash-usage share at point of sale for Montenegro cannot be sourced directly and must be proxied from ATM withdrawal volumes vs card POS turnover in the CBCG quarterly datasets.

negative_findings.description: Searches in Serbian for an Association of Banks of Montenegro ('Udruženje banaka Crne Gore') bulletin with ATM/card statistics returned only CBCG pages and a Serbian banking-association journal article; no live Montenegrin bank-association statistics publication was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: No confirmed URL for a Montenegrin bank association cash/ATM bulletin. Treated as unconfirmed, not as non-existent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: In neighbouring markets the bank association is a key aggregator; its absence or invisibility in Montenegro concentrates dependence on CBCG as effectively the sole aggregator.

negative_findings.description: Euronet is publicly described as operating an Independent ATM Deployment network including Montenegro, but no source was found that attributes Montenegro's ATM estate by operator, and no Montenegro-specific Euronet ATM count was located in the press releases retrieved.
negative_findings.result_summary: IAD presence is credible but unquantified; CBCG acceptance-device counts are unattributed totals.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Independent deployers and bank-owned ATMs imply very different cash-handling procurement channels; the split is currently unobservable from public data.

coverage_gaps.description: The CBCG Annual Work Report and audited financial statements were identified as the likely carriers of cash-operations volumes (cash issued to / received from banks, unfit-note replacement counts, counterfeits withdrawn), but the individual PDFs were not opened and their tables not confirmed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Download the full back-series of Izvještaj o radu CBCG and fs_cbcg_<year>.pdf and keyword-mine for 'gotovin', 'trezor', 'falsifikat', 'novčanic' to confirm which quantitative series actually exist and from which year.

coverage_gaps.description: The quarterly ZIP bundle under 'Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu' was listed by table title only; the actual ATM-vs-POS breakdown granularity, the earliest available quarter, and whether values as well as counts are given were not inspected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Download one recent ZIP and the earliest available ZIP, unpack, and document the exact columns for 'uplate i isplate gotovog novca', 'uređaji za prihvatanje platnih kartica' and 'po vrsti terminala'; then determine the true series start date.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-in-transit / cash-management companies, commercial cash-processing centres and retail cash-back schemes in Montenegro were not searched in this pass, and no local-language term set was exercised for them (e.g. 'transport novca', 'obezbjeđenje i prenos vrijednosti', 'CIT').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sr-language pass on CIT/security-services actors and the Ministry of Interior register of licensed security companies, plus commercial-register (CRPS) filings, to map the private cash-handling layer.

coverage_gaps.description: Customs Administration (Uprava carina Crne Gore) data on declared cross-border cash movements — a genuinely important physical-euro inflow channel for a euroised tourism economy — was inferred from the CBCG declaration rules but never searched directly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search Uprava carina publications and annual reports in Serbian for declared cash-crossing volumes and seizure statistics; also check the Financial Intelligence/AML authority's typology reports.

coverage_gaps.description: Tourism seasonality is the dominant driver of Montenegrin cash demand but the tourism-arrivals and retail-turnover series that would let ATM withdrawal peaks be explained were only pointed at via the MONSTAT publications index, not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate MONSTAT tourism (dolasci i noćenja turista) and trade turnover releases and register them as supporting series for cash-demand seasonality modelling.

coverage_gaps.description: All URLs in this slice come from search results and page navigation; several deep-link paths (regulation index, working-paper index, counterfeiting sub-page in Montenegrin) were constructed from observed site structure rather than fetched individually.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic verification pass resolve every URL; treat any 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than death, and re-derive 404s from the parent section index.

brief: Montenegro's cash-cycle intelligence is almost entirely concentrated in one institution — CBCG — but is scattered across four unconnected areas of its site: the currency section (banknotes, coins, counterfeiting, unfit-note replacement), the payment-system key-function pages, the publications series (Bilten, Annual Report, Annual Work Report, audited financial statements), and secondary legislation. The single highest-value asset is the Montenegrin-language quarterly 'Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu' ZIP bundle, which carries cash deposit/withdrawal transactions, card-acceptance-device counts and card transactions by terminal type; it is not linked from the English Statistics page, so English-only discovery misses it — local-language search was decisive here. Because Montenegro is unilaterally euroised, there is no national currency-in-circulation series at all and no cash-usage survey; CiC exists only as IMF-style estimates and cash share must be proxied from ATM-versus-POS turnover. The main uncovered layers are the private cash-handling chain (CIT and cash-processing firms), operator-level ATM attribution given a confirmed independent-ATM-deployer presence, and customs-declared cross-border cash inflows.
